bundles.name: ia-stats
bundles.description:
Automatic per-agent / per-skill usage tracker. Every event appends a
row to IA_STATS.MD at the consumer project's root via a Node.js
script. Cross-platform (Windows + macOS + Linux), zero npm deps.
Shipped for Claude Code (real event hooks) and OpenCode (plugin
lifecycle hooks). GitHub Copilot ships the read-only `/ia-stats`
skill only — VS Code tasks cannot carry per-event payloads, so no
populating hook is provided.

bundles.name: mvn
bundles.description:
Maven offload — /mvn <goals> dispatches a Maven build off the
parent context so multi-thousand-line build logs do not flood the
conversation. Returns a one-line verdict + Tests counters + failure
cause.

bundles.name: npm
bundles.description:
npm offload — /npm <args> dispatches an npm command off the parent
context so multi-thousand-line Vitest / Vite / lint logs do not flood
the conversation. Returns a one-line verdict + Tests/lint/build
counters + failure cause.

bundles.name: pip
bundles.description:
pip offload — /pip <args> dispatches a Python pip command off the
parent context so multi-thousand-line resolver / install logs do not
flood the conversation. Returns a one-line verdict + counters
(installed / upgraded / removed / failed) + failure cause.
